name: Tall grass
description: Lawn taller than 6 inches.
complaints: Is that a lawn or a hay farm? The limit is 6 inches.
I saw a rabbit go in and not come out. Please measure the grass.
It's technically a meadow, but not an approved one.
false_hints: Measured 5.8 inches. Technically legal.
The mower was in the driveway. It was mowed this morning.
borderline_note: Measured 6.1 inches against a 6.0 inch limit.

name: Dead lawn
description: Lawn is brown and dead beyond seasonal dormancy.
complaints: That lawn has given up on life.
It's brown. In May. Someone should be concerned.
The grass has retired and nobody told the board.
false_hints: Fresh sod, still settling in.
Just a drought patch; the sprinkler schedule is compliant.
borderline_note: Roughly a third of the lawn is brown; the rule says half.

name: Weeds in beds
description: Planting beds overrun with weeds.
complaints: The flower beds are mostly dandelions now.
Those weeds have their own zip code.
false_hints: Wildflowers, labeled and approved by the architectural committee.
borderline_note: A few weeds, but the beds are mostly maintained.

name: Overgrown shrubs
description: Shrubs blocking the walkway or sight lines.
complaints: The hedge has eaten the sidewalk.
I can't see the mailbox through the shrubbery. Neither can the mailman.
false_hints: Trimmed last week. Spring growth looks dramatic.
borderline_note: Hedge is 4 inches over the allowed height.

name: Dead tree
description: Dead tree that could fall on a neighboring lot.
complaints: That tree is dead and leaning toward my fence.
A dead tree in a storm is a lawsuit with leaves.
false_hints: Dormant, not dead. It has buds.
borderline_note: Half the tree is bare; arborist report pending.

name: Unapproved landscaping
description: Rock garden or decor not approved by the committee.
complaints: There are forty gnomes. I counted.
A rock garden appeared overnight. No paperwork.
false_hints: Approved last spring. The approval letter is in the file.
borderline_note: Three gnomes. The rule allows two.

name: RV over 72 hours
description: Recreational vehicle parked in view for more than 72 hours.
complaints: That RV has been there for a week. I have a calendar.
A small cruise ship is parked in a driveway on my street.
false_hints: The RV arrived this morning for loading.
Visiting relatives. They leave in two days.
borderline_note: Parked for 76 hours. Rule says 72.

name: Boat stored outside
description: Boat or trailer stored in view of the street.
complaints: There's a boat in a landlocked subdivision.
Whatever that vessel is, it is not an approved lawn ornament.
false_hints: The boat is behind an approved screen fence.
borderline_note: Half the boat is visible over the fence.

name: Commercial vehicle
description: Vehicle with commercial lettering parked overnight.
complaints: A work van is parked there every night.
That van has a ladder and a logo. Commercial.
false_hints: A personal van with no markings.
borderline_note: Small magnet sign on the door. Might be commercial.

name: Vehicle on lawn
description: Vehicle parked on grass.
complaints: Someone is parking on the lawn like it's a drive-in.
There are tire tracks where the grass used to be.
false_hints: Delivery vehicle, gone within the hour.
borderline_note: Two wheels on the grass, two on the driveway.

name: Inoperable vehicle
description: Vehicle with flat tires or missing parts stored in view.
complaints: That car has been dead since the last election.
A flat tire and a hood propped open. For months.
false_hints: It runs. The tire is being swapped today.
borderline_note: One flat tire and fresh registration.

name: Excess street parking
description: More vehicles parked on the street than the rules allow.
complaints: Five cars on the curb. I counted.
There's a car convention outside my house.
false_hints: A neighbor's birthday party. All gone by tonight.
borderline_note: Three cars on the street. Limit is three.

name: Exterior color violation
description: Exterior color not on the approved palette.
complaints: The house is Eggshell, not Antique Ivory. I have a color chart.
That shade of coral is not on the approved palette.
false_hints: It is Antique Ivory. The light in the photo lies.
borderline_note: A shade lighter than approved.

name: Damaged siding
description: Visible damage to siding or trim.
complaints: Parts of that house are falling off.
The siding is missing planks. Birds are moving in.
false_hints: Shadow from the tree, not damage.
borderline_note: One cracked panel, hardly a crisis.

name: Roof in disrepair
description: Missing shingles or a blue tarp on the roof.
complaints: There is a blue tarp where a roof used to be.
Shingles are in my yard again.
false_hints: Roofers are scheduled. The tarp is temporary and approved.
borderline_note: Two shingles missing.

name: Unapproved fence
description: Fence taller or different from the approved plan.
complaints: That fence is taller than the rules say.
A fence appeared without a permit. It's very confident.
false_hints: Four feet. Exactly to code.
borderline_note: Measured 6 ft 1 in. Approved limit is 6 ft.

name: Unapproved shed
description: Storage shed without architectural approval.
complaints: A shed appeared. Nobody asked the committee.
There's a building in their backyard now.
false_hints: Approved shed. The permit is taped to the door.
borderline_note: Slightly bigger than the approved plan.

name: Unapproved addition
description: Structural addition without approval.
complaints: The house grew a new room. Overnight.
There is scaffolding and no permit.
false_hints: A permitted deck repair.
borderline_note: A covered porch, possibly under the size threshold.

name: Noise complaint
description: Noise outside quiet hours.
complaints: Someone ran a leaf blower at 7:59 AM. Quiet hours begin at 8:00.
There is a drum set. There is always a drum set.
false_hints: A video call. The speaker was loud, not illegal.
borderline_note: Music audible at the property line, barely.

name: Trash left out
description: Trash or bags left outside past collection day.
complaints: Garbage bags are decorating the curb.
Trash day was yesterday. The bags did not get the memo.
false_hints: Collection hasn't happened yet today.
borderline_note: Bins removed 30 minutes late.

name: Bins left at curb
description: Bins left at the curb after collection day.
complaints: The bins have lived at the curb since Tuesday.
Those bins are becoming part of the landscape.
false_hints: Pickup was delayed by the holiday.
borderline_note: Bins out two hours after pickup.

name: Trash or construction debris
description: Dumpster or debris pile left in the yard.
complaints: There's a dumpster in the yard. Permit?
A pile of old lumber has been there for weeks.
false_hints: Active renovation with a permit on file.
borderline_note: A small pile, under the 7-day limit.

name: Pet waste issue
description: Pet waste left on the lawn or common areas.
complaints: I'm stepping carefully on my own street.
A dog has opinions about my lawn.
false_hints: Mulch. Just mulch.
borderline_note: One, long-dried, could be mulch.

name: Expired decorations
description: Seasonal decorations beyond the allowed window.
complaints: My neighbor's inflatable Santa is up. It is October.
Santa needs time to acclimate, but not in July.
false_hints: Decorations are inside the allowed window.
borderline_note: One day past the deadline.

name: Short-term rental activity
description: Frequent turnover of guests suggests a short-term rental.
complaints: A new group of people with suitcases every weekend.
There is a lockbox on the door. This is not a hotel.
false_hints: A family visiting for Thanksgiving.
A relative moving in for a few weeks.
borderline_note: Several guests, one weekend. Could be family.

name: Business traffic
description: Customers visiting a home business.
complaints: People are lining up at that house all day.
That's not a book club. That's a salon.
false_hints: Piano lessons for one student. Allowed.
borderline_note: Two visitors, once. Hard to call it a business.

name: Unapproved yard sign
description: Sign not allowed by the declaration.
complaints: There's a political sign. In a place where signs are not allowed.
A sign advertising a very specific lawn guy.
false_hints: A realtor sign. Allowed for 30 days.
borderline_note: A small sign, partly hidden by a shrub.

name: Basketball hoop in street
description: Portable hoop left in the street or sidewalk.
complaints: A basketball hoop is on the road. I am not Michael Jordan's insurance.
Kids are dunking on my street.
false_hints: Hoop is on the driveway, inside the lot line.
borderline_note: Hoop base is two inches over the curb.

name: Sidewalk obstruction
description: The public sidewalk must stay clear of plants, bins and materials.
complaints: The hedge has swallowed half the sidewalk. Strollers can't get by.
I had to walk in the street because of the bushes at this house.
Something is blocking the sidewalk in front of this property again.
A low branch is blocking the walk. I keep getting hit in the face.
false_hints: The sidewalk is clear. The hedge was trimmed last week.
Nothing blocks the walk; the complaint may be about the neighbor's yard.
borderline_note: The hedge overhangs about six inches. Walkers can still pass.
